style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
subject: ONE male mara, long legged patagonian cavy, grey brown fur, white rump, ears flat back
second_characters: burrowing owls in neckties like estate agents, at the lens every beat

props.blocks: grey concrete blocks the owls shove at him, one at a time; ONE flat slab at 7.85

environment: noon patagonian steppe, dry tussock grass, low thorn bushes, his burrow mouth in the mid ground, pale sky
lighting: white daylight from above, hard cyan rim left, warm amber kick right
motion_rule: The world flies at the hero: the steppe and the owls rush INTO the lens while he drives across frame toward his burrow in long bounds. An owl crosses the lens every beat. The camera never stops, new shot size every beat, one hero action per beat, he fills half the frame height, muzzle to the lens, medium to close.

audio.rate: 3.7 syllables per second; each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0; speech ends by 7.30; then only wind and grass rattle
audio.lip_sync: muzzle to the lens, jaw opens on every syllable, mouth empty while speaking
audio.pronunciation: MA-ry, RO-yem, vle-ZA-yem, dol-go-VO-ye, be-TON, za-BUD-te

timeline.a: already huge in frame, a concrete block balanced on his back, he hurls his whole body a full length across the steppe and shrugs the block off at the lens; an owl swerves past the lens after it
he drives a full body length over the tussocks, raking a spray of earth at the lens with his forepaws; two owls tear across the lens
he hurls his body the other way past a thorn bush and boots a block across frame; an owl shoves the next one into the lens
he drives at full stretch toward the burrow mouth, blocks rushing past the lens on both sides; an owl banks into the lens with another
he swings his whole body sideways and slams a block away with his hip on the move; owls scatter off the lens
he bounds a full length, ears flat, the burrow mouth swelling in frame; an owl drops a block across his path and he clears it
muzzle to the lens, he throws his body the last length at the burrow mouth; owls stream into the lens behind him
he lunges head first into the lens until his muzzle fills the frame, then drops down the burrow mouth; the owls peel off into the depth
only his hind legs kick above the hole, throwing earth across frame; ONE owl lands at the mouth with a flat slab
one paw shoots up out of the hole, claws at the slab and is gone; the owl drags the slab over the mouth and stamps it down as two more owls tear across the lens
close on the flat grey slab pressed over the burrow mouth, ONE owl stamps it down and swings its necktie into the lens, grass tearing past on both sides

must_appear: a concrete block rides his back at 0.00 and he shrugs it off; he boots or clears a block away in the spoken beats; he drops down the burrow mouth at 7.30; the owl slides the flat slab over the hole at 8.50; at 9.25 close on the slab over the hole, one owl stamping it down
negative_prompt: silent opening, still last second, hero riding anything, conveyor belt, cart, rail, view from behind, lowered head during speech, parked camera, push in, motionless background, bobbing up and down, printed words, digits, Cyrillic or Latin, price tag, speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, night, dark scene, black bars, horizontal frame, speech after 7.30, English speech, foreign accent, human hands, extra limbs, a second mara, wide shot, duplicate props
